name: Hungary: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Hungary package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed-consent procedure present with the Hungarian national content and a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2: every final participant-facing recruitment item in Hungarian; no English-only advertisement.
One combined L1 information and consent document per population, and every population-specific document whose population set trigger is true.
Separate genetic information and consent document for every population with planned genetic testing.
Final Hungarian patient emergency card as an addendum to the main ICF.

For every Hungarian site: Hungary-template CVs of the PI and co-investigators, PI declaration of interest, GCP evidence (in the CV or separate), signed protocol signature pages, and the ETT-KFEB Hungary-modified site suitability form.
Insurance policy and insurance confirmation or certificate (O1, O2).
P1 compensation statement and P2 financial information per site (full amount and distribution to site, PI and team).
Hungarian-language cover letter and Hungarian list of the Part II documents.
No R1 or S1 form planned unless decided otherwise (DECISIONS.md D9); privacy and sample information present in each participant document instead.
Every participant-facing and recruitment document is in final, natural Hungarian.
Cover letter and Part II document list in Hungarian; other administrative documents in the language decided (DECISIONS.md D1).
Participant information and consent forms submitted as final blank forms; no participant, representative, investigator or witness signature in the CTIS copies.
Protocol signature or acceptance pages signed by the relevant investigators.
Every signature or declaration field of the CV, DoI and site-suitability templates completed; no national field removed.
Insurance evidence signed or authenticated as the issuing document requires.
Compensation amounts, cost types and conditions identical in P1 and every participant document.
Insurer, Hungarian contact, contact person and telephone number identical in O1/O2 and every participant document.
Sample types, storage, transfers and retention identical in the protocol and every participant document, including genetic and secondary-use documents.
Data categories, coding terminology, recipients, transfers and retention identical across all participant documents and the protocol.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 documents in the package.
Emergency contacts identical on the card, in the ICF and in the site information.
Document names, versions and dates identical in the cover letter, the Hungarian document list, the uploads and the document footers.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Hungarian national additions and no leftovers from the reference country (foreign laws, other insurers, other signature logic).
items.applies_when: Hungary is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B-S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document.

Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, only the fields that distinguish the document; _HU_hu on participant-facing documents.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2); none for co-investigators.
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished; for substantial modifications new or revised documents in clean and tracked form where applicable.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Hungary receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised rules applicable from 18 June 2024; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).

Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material, irreversibly; signatures (protocol signature pages, CV, DoI, site form) never disclosed.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
Every open decision in countries/HU/DECISIONS.md that affects this package is answered.
